rationale: FAMILY CONTRACT: cyclomatic complexity = 1 + decisions; decisions = if + for + ternary + && = 4, so f must be exactly 5. An else clause NEVER adds. The old symbol counter had no base AND double-counted else_clause - two errors that canceled to the right answer on this shape, hiding the defect from casual checks; shapes without else or with multiple elses diverged from every other language.
